title: settlement failure ratio above objective
body: Alert settlement-failures fired at 16:00:44Z. Settlement attempts failing reached 0.61 against an objective of 0.02. The alert did not clear until 18:12:30Z.

title: connection pool exhausted
body: settlement-worker: database connection pool exhausted from 15:58:10Z. Pool size 20, checked-out 20, queue depth rising. Errors: pool_timeout after 5000ms. Affects approximately 0.38 of attempts.

title: feature-flag service token rejected
body: settlement-worker: calls to flags.internal returning 401 invalid_token from 15:59:02Z. The worker fails closed when it cannot read the settlement_v2_enabled flag. Affects approximately 0.31 of attempts, overlapping with pool_timeout failures on some attempts.

title: settlement-worker concurrency increase
body: Configuration change at 15:55:00Z raised settlement-worker concurrency from 8 to 32 workers. The database connection pool size was left at 20 and is not derived from the worker count.

title: feature-flag service token expiry
body: The service token settlement-worker uses for flags.internal was issued for 90 days on 2025-11-13 and expired at 15:59:00Z on 2026-02-11. Its renewal was not automated. This expiry is unrelated to the concurrency change applied four minutes earlier.

title: pool enlarged, failures reduced but not resolved
body: settlement-worker: connection pool raised to 64 at 17:20:15Z. pool_timeout errors stopped. Settlement failure ratio fell from 0.61 to 0.29 and did not fall further.

title: token replaced, failures resolved
body: settlement-worker: a replacement token for flags.internal was installed at 18:12:10Z. 401 responses stopped and the settlement failure ratio fell from 0.29 to 0.004.

title: settlement failure ratio series
body: Series settlement_failure_ratio: 0.61 from 16:00Z, stepping down to 0.29 at 17:20Z and to 0.004 at 18:12Z. The series shows two distinct step changes, each aligned with a different remediation.

title: responder expects full recovery after pool fix
body: Responder R: 'Pool is at 64 now and pool_timeout is gone, so we should be recovered. Why are we still failing 29% of settlements?'

title: responder identifies the second fault
body: Responder S: 'Because there are two faults, not one. The pool exhaustion came from the concurrency change at 15:55. Separately, the flags.internal token expired at 15:59. They started four minutes apart and neither explains the other.'

title: remaining questions
body: Responder S: 'Both are fixed. Nobody has established why pool size is not derived from worker concurrency, and nobody has audited which other service tokens are on manual renewal.'

title: INC-2201 opened
body: INC-2201 opened at 16:05:00Z, severity 1, title 'Settlements failing'. The ticket records no settlement value at risk and no such figure was added before resolution.
